text:
priya: Hey team - PR #13821 is ready for review. Change set: optimize batching + KV-cache fallback to reduce cold-start tail. Requesting non-blocking approvals from runtime (@sam), infra (@kevin) and security (@lina). Planning a canary tomorrow in the 06:00 UTC window. Quick checklist below and a short merge plan.

sam: Thanks — can you paste the perf numbers and any new flamegraphs?

priya: Sure. TL;DR: p50 gen latency down 28ms -> 25ms, p95 down 120ms -> 95ms, throughput +12% on typical batch mix. Memory increased ~2% at peak. Full results: https://perf.redwood.int/report/13821 (internal). Flamegraph: attached in PR.

kevin: Does this require any kube node or runtime config changes (eviction headers, extra mounts, or cgroup changes)? I need to know before I eyeball the merge window.

priya: No node or infra-level config changes. This is purely runtime code + a small routing policy flag. No new mounts. No scheduling or cgroup knobs touched. I did add a new optional env var REDWOOD_BATCH_SHARD for tuning but it defaults to previous behavior.

lina: Security: any change to KMS usage or token handling? Also need to know if any new telemetry or PII is being added to logs.

priya: No KMS changes. We log only anonymized latency counts; no request/response payloads or PII. CI includes a smoke test that runs with the same key material and audit logging remains unchanged.

sam: Looks reasonable. Two asks before +1: 1) include a short rollback test in the canary job (verify kv-cache disabled path). 2) Add a perf regression gate in the PR (we already have the numbers but want an automated check).

priya: Will do. I'll add a canary job step that toggles KV cache off and validates p50/p95 within slack thresholds. Also adding the perf gate script under .ci/perf_gate.sh.

kevin: If infra isn't changing I'm fine with the window. Can you state exact rollout steps? I want to coordinate with autoscaler on-call in case of churn.

priya: Rollout plan (short):
```
# merge PR
./tools/merge-pr 13821 --squash
# canary
deploy set canary pr=13821 percent=5 duration=30m
monitor perf-dashboard/pr-13821
if steady -> increase canary to 20% for 30m
if steady -> 100% rollout
rollback: deploy set canary pr=13821 percent=0 (or rollback to previous model tag)
```

priya: Canary window requested: tomorrow 06:00 UTC; initial 5% for 30m -> 20% for 30m -> full. @kevin can you confirm autoscaler on-call will watch? @sam can you +1 for runtime once I add the regression gate? @lina please ack on security if log/KMS answers look ok.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: PR 13821 -> 2025-11-05 06:00 UTC (canary jobs queued) :rocket:

lina: Acked from security side. No KMS or PII changes detected. Please make sure the perf logs redact any user ids (should be covered).

sam: I'll review the perf gate change in the PR now. If I don't find issues I'll +1 by EOD.

kevin: Autoscaler on-call confirmed (pager duty team A). I'm good from infra; no infra changes to block.

priya: Thanks all — added perf_gate.sh and the canary rollback smoke test to the PR. Requesting final +1s for merge.

sam: +1 (runtime)

kevin: +1 (infra)

lina: +1 (security)

priya: Awesome, merging during the window. I'll ping the channel when started and again if we need rollback. :thumbsup:
